view.name: Subscriptions feed
view.description: RSS subscription feed with channel avatar strip and a grid of feed item cards showing queue status.

regions.label: 80px icon rail with VidBee logo, Home, Subscribe (active, orange tinted tile), Tools, and Preferences/About icons pinned to bottom
Horizontal strip of channel avatar buttons (All + 8 subscriptions) with status dots; selecting one filters the grid; dashed 'Add subscription' button at right
4-column grid of video cards with channel chip, thumbnail or 'No thumbnail' placeholder, publish datetime, Queued/Not queued pill and bold title

evidence.note: Persistent icon+label rail with fixed destinations; Subscribe active
'All' is pressed; clicking a channel avatar live-filtered the grid to that channel's videos
Merged stream of latest videos from subscribed channels, newest first, scrolling
Card with 'No thumbnail' gray gradient media, channel chip overlay, date, status pill, title below

evidence.quote: 十年老笔记本还能干什么？

evidence.note: Green status pill on thumbnail; 'Not queued' dark variant
Green/red status dot on channel avatar (red = error/outdated)
Live: hovering a channel avatar shows a card below with name, 'Up to date', 'Updated: 2026-11-17 22:18' (not in capture)

patterns.rationale: Only seen in the live page on hover; could also be coded as a rich tooltip
Hover card on avatars coded as popover (multi-line read-only preview) rather than tooltip
An 'Automated Subscriptions with RSSHub' promo block exists below the grid in the DOM but falls outside the captured 5400px

structure.layout: desktop app shell: narrow 80px left icon rail (logo, Home/Subscribe/Tools, settings/about at bottom) and main area with a horizontal channel-avatar filter strip above a 4-column grid of video cards, ordered newest first

aesthetics.typography: Open Sans throughout: bold 16px card titles, 12px overlay text (channel chip, date, status pill), 12px labels under avatars and nav icons
aesthetics.typeScale: Compact: 16px bold titles vs 12-14px regular metadata; no large headings; thumbnails carry big generated title text

notes: Thumbnails are 16:9-ish rounded (18px) tiles; missing thumbnails show a light-gray-to-dark-gray vertical gradient with centered 'No thumbnail', and all thumbnails get a dark bottom scrim carrying white datetime and a pill (green 'Queued' / black 'Not queued') — indicating download-queue state. Channel name sits in a translucent dark pill with a small colored initials avatar at the top-left of each thumbnail. Channel avatars are colorful gradient circles with initials; 'All' uses a grid icon in a gray rounded tile when selected. Add-subscription is a dashed-circle '+' button. Sidebar active item gets a pale orange rounded square with orange RSS icon; logo is a beehive. The main area scrolls in its own panel. Below the grid (outside capture) is an RSSHub promo with 'Open RSSHub Documentation' button.
